title: Sky platformer
description: Playable side-scrolling platformer (16:9): a rigged KayKit knight runs and jumps (physics character controller with coyote time) across floating grass platforms, a sliding lift and an elevator lift, collects 13 coins and reaches the goal flag against a 90 s timer — 3 lives, checkpoints, best time saved, synth sounds, keyboard + touch (hold a side to run, tap the middle to jump), self-playing attract mode, floating islands and clouds behind.
